content: The Founder puts his coffee down too hard and it slops onto the grid. 'Eight weeks is a promise I made to the people who bought Archive 001. Every week we slip, they think we've vanished. Faceless and late is exactly the story the skeptics told. You're asking me to prove them right in the name of fixing trust.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals
disagreement: Founder (hold the 8-week Archive 002 date) vs Ops/Plant/HoP (date follows the launch gates)

content: Head of Product doesn't raise their voice. 'Or you launch on time with a blind prepay, a seed we haven't tested and a date Ops didn't sign, and you prove them right a different way. I'm not asking you to slip. I'm asking that the date be an output of the gates, not an input.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Research gives the uncomfortable fact. 'Our tests need about two to three weeks of real traffic to tell us anything. If the link opens in week 4, we're launching before our own evidence comes in. That's the trade.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Brand sees both sides at once. A date kept is a promise kept, but a drop that rushes its own story isn't a drop. They suspect the Founder already knows Ops is right and is arguing with his own deadline.
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: The Designer quietly mops the coffee off the grid with a paper towel and finds the F5 effort cell, 'weeks - depends on product', has smudged into something unreadable.
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: The Plant Specialist speaks gently. 'The plant doesn't care about promises. If Archive 002 arrives in the wrong season for whatever we're sending, the dead seeds come back and everything we've built this week goes in the bin. I need the dispatch window before I can tell you whether eight weeks is a good date or a bad one.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Growth, surprisingly, tries to find a middle. 'What if we split announcing from opening? Open the waitlist now with bench content and the germination time-lapse. That's Research's test vehicle anyway. People see we're alive. The preorder link opens only when the gates are green. Nobody thinks we've vanished, and nobody prepays blind.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

proposals.text: Split 'announce' from 'open': waitlist live now (bench content, time-lapse, tests); preorder link opens only when the launch gate is green
proposals.test: waitlist signups over time; the A/B tests run on it

content: Community: 'Vanishing is a communication problem, not a date problem. Weekly posts from the bench, the bloom-or-not replies, the registry filling up. People will know exactly where we are, even if the date moves.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: CX: 'Archive 001 buyers are going to hear from us in week 1 anyway with the bloom-or-not message and the remedy offer. That's the opposite of vanishing.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Ops doesn't flinch. 'You painted tins with a stopwatch running on Day 2. You know how long it took. I'm not going to say a number in front of everyone. But you know it's not the number you had in your head when you said eight weeks.' They let it sit.
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Finance adds the cash view, carefully. 'A late date announced in advance costs us nothing. A missed date after preorders are taken costs refunds against the cap. Purely on money, I side with gates.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals

content: Legal: 'Growth's split works for me. A waitlist takes no money, so the accuracy bar is lower. Just don't put a launch date on the waitlist page that isn't signed off. Verify the waitlist wording with a professional as part of the combined pack.'
round_time: Late morning, Day 4 - Trade-offs: speed to Archive 002 vs fundamentals
